sentences.en: The municipal council all but ignored the gravity of the pollution.
sentences.zh: 市政委员会几乎完全忽视了污染的严重性。

sentences.en: The municipal council should concentrate more on specific issues.
sentences.zh: 市政委员会应该更专注于具体问题。

sentences.en: Many offices of the municipal government are in the town hall.
sentences.zh: 市政府的许多办公室设在市政厅内。
